messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, AsterTech Security <security@astertech.com>, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@auditorco.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-Boarding QA: simulated offboard + training matrix and clearance ledger request

Hi team —

Per Halcyon Bank's SIG follow-up, they're asking for a short, demonstrable bundle that shows how us/new starters are onboarded and how offboarding revocations are exercised. Rather than sending static artifacts, the auditor suggested a 1-day simulated offboard so we can show logs, automation, and redaction end-to-end.

What I'm proposing:
- Run a simulated offboard of a test account on 2026-11-16 (Tuesday) during the 10:00–13:00 PST window.
- Produce: clearance ledger extract (CSV), training completions snapshot (PDF), deprovision logs (system and AD), and a redaction sample.
- Provide the preboarding training matrix and a short playbook for the simulation.

Attachments: preboarding-training-matrix-v2.xlsx, clearance-ledger-sample.csv, simulated-offboard-playbook.pdf

AsterTech — can you confirm you'll observe the network/API side and capture evidence of token revocation? Auditor team — please confirm the artifact formats you'd accept (CSV, signed PDF ok?).

Next steps: I can coordinate HR/IT tasks and will loop in CS if we need to include customer-facing routing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: AsterTech Security <security@astertech.com>, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@auditorco.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-Boarding QA: simulated offboard + training matrix and clearance ledger request

Thanks Kim — this sounds good. A couple clarifications before we lock the date:
1) Sample size: do auditors want the full ledger for all employees or a scoped sample (e.g., 20 test identities)? Scoping will let us avoid exposing PII.
2) Redaction approach: we'll provide a redacted copy plus a signed internal attestation describing the redaction rules. Is that acceptable?
3) IT automation: I'll need confirmation that the service account we'll use for the simulation has the same permission set as a real offboard path so logs are representative.

I recommend we include a quick tabletop on 2026-11-09 (30 min) to confirm roles. Happy to own running the playbook with IT.

-- Rishi
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Kimberly, Marissa, Rishi —

Thanks for the proposal. CSV and signed PDF are fine. AsterTech's observation is useful; we'd like to see both the application-level token revocation and the IAM-level account disablement. For artifacts we need:
- Redacted clearance ledger (CSV) + hash/checksum
- Training completion evidence (PDF scan of LMS report)
- Deprovision logs (AD and service logs) with timestamps and actor ids
- A short narrative (1 page) describing redaction method and sampling rationale

We accept hashed identifiers as long as you include a separate internal attestation describing the salt storage and access controls.

Confirming the auditor team will be present for the simulation window; we'll share a simple observation checklist by 2026-11-09.

Regards,
SOC2 Audit Team
